candidate.answerReason: The decrease is y-x, measured relative to the comparison value y. Multiplying this ratio by 100 gives choice C.

methods.label: Identify the comparison base
methods.explanation:
The phrase “\(x\) is less than \(y\)” uses \(y\) as the comparison base. The amount of the decrease is \(y-x\). Since \(y>0\), divide the decrease by \(y\) and multiply by \(100\) to obtain the requested percent:
\[
\frac{y-x}{y}\cdot100=\frac{100(y-x)}{y}.
\]
The answer is \(\dfrac{100(y-x)}{y}\), choice C.
